answer: Buying 7 genuinely separate vantage points per alias is the adversary's cost, and each one has to keep a basalt record clean through the terrace check. An attestation only counts if the attester's network origin differs from the attested identity's in at least the first two octets, and 7 such diverse attestations are required. Clones sharing one datacenter or one proxy pool produce a falcon signature that collapses to a single origin, which means the cluster is discounted at settlement. That is 35 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
